notes: Rules are enforced twice: results.record (GET and POST guards, rendering result.html) and services.record_result (under the round lock). Both filter the result by tester, refuse Closed rounds and refuse a submitted result, so M1, M3 and M4 edit both; M4 also lets result.html show the form, with the true status, for a submitted result. ResultForm.clean requires a Fail observation and ObservationField limits it to OBSERVATION_MAX; M5 raises only the field's max_length, so its message is unchanged. M3 leaves the tester round page's Open-only link in place (navigation, not a guard). M5 also widens the model field and its column in migration 0005 to 2001, together, because the varchar(2000) column would otherwise refuse the save (a 503) and a model-only change would fail the candidate's makemigrations --check test; pytest-django builds the test database from migrations on every run (no --reuse-db), so the migration edit is seen consistently.
